title: Points of a fibre product of schemes
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:Y\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with fibre product $X\times_SY$ and projections $p,q$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Points $z$ of $X\times_SY$ are in bijective correspondence with quadruples $(x,y,s,\mathfrak p)$ where $x\in X$, $y\in Y$, $s\in S$ with $f(x)=s=g(y)$ and $\mathfrak p$ is a prime ideal of $\kappa(x)\otimes_{\kappa(s)}\kappa(y)$ (residue fields [def-weil-residue-field], with the maps $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(x)$, $\kappa(s)\to\kappa(y)$ induced by $f$ and $g$); under this correspondence $p(z)=x$ and $q(z)=y$. In particular, for fixed $x,y$ with $f(x)=g(y)=s$, the set $p^{-1}(x)\cap q^{-1}(y)$ is in bijection with $\operatorname{Spec}(\kappa(x)\otimes_{\kappa(s)}\kappa(y))$.
